reference_document: GM_PlanPistes-1.pdf (user supplied; official Grand Massif map)
method: OSM exact names inventory plus explicitly named fun and freeride zones from official map legend. No piste-level official matches are asserted.

osm_named_inventory.osm_name: Route de Desserte de Flaine Forum

official_special_zones.name: Gape
official_special_zones.note: Corrected from Agate: official 2025/26 Grand Massif map freeride legend lists Gape. Agate exists as an OSM piste name but is not this official freeride-zone label.

limitations: Official piste names and colour for every individual run have not yet been transcribed/verified from the map artwork.
OSM named segments are not equivalent to official piste counts.
The map is for 2025/26, not confirmed 2026/27.
Candidate special-zone name matches are not geographic verification.

official_sources.description: Official piste-status page snapshot: 9 green, 29 blue, 26 red, 6 black (sum 70); page also displays 0/82 open, inconsistent with both breakdown and brochure
Official map, colour-coded trails; no structured list of individual pistes

notes: The conflicting official counts must be resolved before calculating a match rate.
The 157 named OSM pistes span the broader Grand Massif extraction; do not treat all as Flaine pistes.
Piste-level official classification and geographic boundaries require review; no automated area assignment asserted.
Initial 24-name Flaine-focused review queue added; entries are NOT counted as official matches.
Corrected official freeride-zone legend: Gape, Combe de Véret, Onyx (Combe de Gers). Agate was a transcription error.
